target.title: fix: persist queued iOS watch replies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes iOS watch quick replies being held only in memory after the phone receives them while disconnected from the gateway. If the app process was terminated before reconnecting, those queued replies could be silently lost.

## Why This Change Was Made

Watch quick replies now use a UserDefaults-backed queue scoped to the current gateway stable ID. Reconnect flushing peeks queued replies, forwards them through a confirmed `node.event` request, and removes them only after delivery succeeds; failed sends are left queued for a later reconnect.

## User Impact

Users can tap watch quick replies while the phone is offline and still have those replies delivered after the iOS app restarts and reconnects, without replaying stale replies into a different gateway.

## Evidence

- `swiftc -parse apps/ios/Sources/Services/NodeServiceProtocols.swift apps/ios/Sources/Model/WatchReplyCoordinator.swift apps/ios/Sources/Model/NodeAppModel.swift apps/ios/Tests/NodeAppModelInvokeTests.swift`
- `git diff --check`
- Full iOS `xcodebuild` test/build not run locally: `xcodegen` is not installed and `xcodebuild` points to Command Line Tools instead of full Xcode (`/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools`).
- `swiftformat --lint ...` not run: `swiftformat` is not installed.
- Autoreview skipped at requester direction after interim findings were addressed.
